findings.title: 2026 actual return omitted rental income and private-use addition for non-main property
findings.closure: Current-law non-main property now models rental/pacht cash income and the 2026 5.06% private-use addition, includes them in the actual-return comparison, and exposes the components in annual audit buckets.

findings.title: Future/transition path used generic accrual treatment for non-main real estate
findings.closure: Tax-adjusted non-main-property scenarios are explicitly blocked under Future or Transition Box 3 until the proposal's real-estate-specific capital-gains/direct-return branch is implemented.

findings.title: Enhanced NHG check did not independently cap the non-energy cost stack at EUR 470,000
findings.closure: For the supported existing-home purchase route, the exact NHG gate independently enforces a-g <= EUR 470,000 and a-h <= EUR 498,200 plus the related loan/energy caps. The simplified Mortgage-tab route cannot return an NHG pass without exact inputs.

findings.title: Manual transfer-tax mode could fall through as a main residence for Box 1 / Box 3 routing
findings.closure: Property-use classification is now explicit and independent from transfer-tax mode; manual transfer tax no longer decides Box 1 versus Box 3 treatment.

findings.title: Erfpacht and qualifying purchase-financing costs were not passed into deductible own-home costs
findings.closure: Itemized periodic erfpacht and the explicitly classified deductible financing-cost subset are routed into the annual Box 1 bridge. The automatic NHG fee is limited to the Box 1 qualifying-debt share; hidden/non-itemized ground lease is not silently deducted.

findings.title: Exports and calculation evidence lacked immutable exact source/build identity
findings.closure: R6.6 is frozen to calculation-source SHA 31c08ffea3cb94e66692ad4c9505b2b7b8778e61 and build ID R6.6-stage10-31c08ffe; canonical export evidence carries both values.

findings.title: Development Playwright dependency reports an advisory and lockfile contains an extraneous absolute-path entry
findings.required_action: Regenerate the lockfile in a clean environment and upgrade/re-audit the development-only Playwright dependency before security-clean sign-off.

findings.title: Box 3 payment is modeled at calendar-year end rather than actual assessment/payment date
The 0.1 percentage-point break-even scan is numerical rather than a mathematical proof against arbitrarily close double roots
findings.required_action: Retain numerical-search wording; adaptive subdivision remains optional hardening.

findings.title: Rental-income field says gross rent even though current-law actual return uses received basic rent (kale huur), excluding service charges
findings.required_action: Rename and explain the input as annual basic rent/pacht received, excluding service charges, while retaining the rule that ordinary property operating/maintenance costs are not deducted from current-law actual Box 3 return.

findings.title: Exact NHG a-g/a-h rule is an existing-home rule but the public purchase route does not explicitly exclude or separately model new-build purchases
findings.required_action: Either mark/block the current NHG purchase route as existing-home-only or implement the separate 2026 new-build NHG C.2.2 item structure and associated purchase-tax/VAT treatment.
